title: Passwords, Authentication and Secure Devices
summary: Practical security habits for accounts, devices and remote working that protect the firm's systems and data wherever staff work.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Practical security habits for accounts, devices and remote working that protect the firm's systems and data wherever staff work.
Learning Objectives: Apply strong password and multi-factor authentication practices
Secure laptops, mobile devices and removable media
Work securely from home, while travelling and on public networks
Syllabus: Passphrases, password managers and multi-factor authentication
Software updates, approved devices and lost or stolen equipment
Remote and hybrid working, public wi-fi and screen privacy
Access rights, least privilege and joiners, movers and leavers
Intended Audience: All staff in regulated firms, including new joiners, contractors and temporary staff with access to the firm's systems
Front-office, operations, technology, HR, finance and support staff who handle customer data or critical processes
Line managers responsible for secure working practices and continuity arrangements in their teams
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: No technical background is required. The programme is suitable for new joiners and as annual refresher training.
Core Reading: ISO/IEC (2022), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security, Cybersecurity and Privacy Protection – Information Security Management Systems – Requirements
ISO (2019), ISO 22301:2019 Security and Resilience – Business Continuity Management Systems – Requirements
